app.name: FOCUS
app.updateReady: A new version of FOCUS is ready.

capture.title: Capture
capture.hint: Enter saves to the inbox. Shift+Enter starts a new line; each line becomes its own item.
capture.triageOneAtATime: Triage works on one item at a time.
capture.doItNowHint: Then mark it done. It goes into the log.
capture.urgent: Would something go wrong if it waits until tomorrow?
capture.urgentHint: Someone is blocked, a real deadline passes today, or money, health or safety is at stake.
capture.urgentProbe: What actually happens if this waits a day?
capture.bumpBody: Your One Thing moves to the first slot on {{day}}. That's the plan working, not failing.
capture.bumpConfirm: Move it and do this now
capture.urgentNoOneThing: It goes on today's list. Today's One Thing is already settled.
capture.urgentToast: On today's list. One Thing moved to {{day}}.
capture.urgentKeptToast: On today's list. {{day}} keeps its One Thing.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.intro: Captured items wait here until a shutdown or weekly review decides them.
inbox.parkedToast: Parked as a project idea until {{date}}.

oneThing.label: The One Thing
oneThing.doneState: One Thing done at {{time}}. The rest is bonus.
oneThing.tinyState: First step done at {{time}} (low-energy day). The rest is bonus.
oneThing.none: No One Thing set for today.
oneThing.dayOffNone: Day off. No One Thing needed.

nextAction.title: {{project}}: next action done
nextAction.placeholder: e.g. Email Tom about the venue
nextAction.fromList: Or take one of its tasks:

rituals.shutdownBody: About 5 minutes, then you're done for today.

routine.missed2: Missed 2 days in a row. The tiny version counts today.

rest.title: Rest
rest.body: {{minutes}} min, protected. Rest is part of the work, not a reward.

other.title: Other tasks today
other.buffer: Keep about {{minutes}} min unplanned for surprises.
other.guard: Is this your One Thing? Have you done it yet?

lowEnergy.title: Low-energy day?
lowEnergy.body: The One Thing shrinks to its first step, routines switch to their tiny versions, and the rest block grows by 30 minutes. This is logged.
lowEnergy.on: Low-energy day. The first step counts.

picker.reasonBumped: Moved here when something urgent came up.
picker.reasonCarriedTiny: Only the first step was done on {{day}}. Carried over.
picker.reasonProject: Next action of {{project}}, your top Active project.
picker.reasonNone: No default: no Active project has a next action.
picker.newPlaceholder: A concrete action, e.g. Email Tom about X
picker.firstStepHint: Something you can start in under 2 minutes, like “open the doc and write one ugly sentence”.

projects.title: Projects
projects.emptyActive: No Active project. Pick 1 to 3 to focus on.
projects.name: Name
projects.nextActionHint: A concrete physical action, like “email Tom about X”, not “work on X”.
projects.nextActionDone: Next action done. Needs a new one.
projects.personHint: A real person makes a deadline count.
projects.obstacle: What's most likely to stall this?
projects.ifThen: If that happens, then I will…

errors.next-action-required: An Active project needs a next action.
errors.reconsider-date-required: A Parked project needs a date to reconsider.
errors.max-active: 3 projects are Active. Park one to make room.

room.title: 3 projects are Active
room.body: Park one to make room. It comes back in the weekly review on its reconsider date.

skip.title: Skip for now?
skip.body: Write down why. The reason is logged and listed at your next weekly review.
skip.label: Reason
skip.placeholder: e.g. Train delayed, doing it at lunch

dump.title: Brain dump
dump.body: Everything still on your mind, one per line. It goes to the inbox so your head can let go.
dump.placeholder:
Call the bank
Reply to Mia
…

facts.oneThingTiny: One Thing: first step done at {{time}}.
facts.oneThingBumped: One Thing: moved for something urgent.

glance.energy: Best energy: {{from}}–{{to}}. Put the One Thing there.
glance.noDeadlines: No deadlines in the next 7 days.

shutdown.title: Shutdown
shutdown.pickSubtitle: For {{day}}. Do it first, in your best-energy window.
shutdown.finishBody: Everything open is captured. Tomorrow's One Thing is set.
shutdown.endBody: Shutdown at {{time}}. Rest is part of the work.

checkin.title: Morning check-in
checkin.subtitle: No shutdown on {{day}}. Five minutes now, then the day is yours.

restart.title: Welcome back.
restart.subtitle: No catching up needed. About 15 minutes to restart from today.
restart.projectsBody: Keep, park or let go. Each Active project needs a next action.

overwhelm.title: Overwhelm reset
overwhelm.dumpBody: Get everything out of your head, one per line. About a minute.
overwhelm.stepBody: Something you can start in under a minute.

review.title: Weekly review
review.subtitle: About 20 minutes. Decide calmly now, so the week runs on defaults.
review.inboxBody: Decide each item. Nothing stays undecided.
review.activeBody: Keep, park, kill or finish each one. Active projects need a next action.
review.parkedBody: Projects whose reconsider date has come are at the top.
review.confirmTooMany: {{n}} projects are Active. Park or finish some to get to 3.
review.confirmNone: No project is Active. Continuing without one needs a reason.
review.obstacleBody: For each Active project: what's most likely to stall it this week, and what will you do then?
review.shareBody: Optional. FOCUS writes a plain summary; you decide whether to send it.
review.gatesHint: Gates can only be turned off here, or elsewhere with a logged reason.

facts.oneThing_one: One Thing: done on {{done}} of {{count}} workday.
facts.oneThing_other: One Thing: done on {{done}} of {{count}} workdays.
facts.oneThingDetail: First step only (low-energy): {{tiny}}. Moved for something urgent: {{bumped}}. Not done: {{open}}. None set: {{none}}.

setup.welcomeBody: One trusted place for your projects, your One Thing and your daily rituals. Decide in advance, then act by default.
setup.welcomeRules: FOCUS logs everything with timestamps. If you skip a shutdown or a weekly review, it opens straight into it. Skipping takes a written reason.
setup.welcomeTime: Setup takes about 10 minutes. Keep it rough; you can improve it at weekly reviews.
setup.projectsBody: One per line: work, studies, personal, all of it.
setup.sortBody: At most 3 Active: your focus right now. Parked is a decision, not a failure. Dead means let go.
setup.routineBody: The small daily tasks that keep getting skipped. Bundle them behind something you already do every day.
setup.restBody: What actually recharges you? Walks, sport, people. Not scrolling.
setup.personBody: Someone who will know your deadlines. A real person makes them count.

focus.label: Focus
focus.running: Focus session running: {{title}}, {{time}} left. Open timer.

log.title: Log
log.intro: Everything FOCUS recorded, as plain facts.

events.onething_tiny: First step of the One Thing done: “{{title}}”.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dayStartHint: Before this hour it still counts as the previous day.
settings.gatesBody: If yesterday's shutdown or this week's review was skipped, FOCUS opens straight into it.
settings.gatesOffBody: Gates can be turned off during a weekly review. To turn them off now, write down why. The reason is logged.
settings.remindersBody: Calendar reminders for your One Thing window, the shutdown and the weekly review. Any calendar app will alert you; no account needed.
settings.reminderOneThingBody: Start your One Thing now. First step only.
settings.reminderShutdownBody: 5 minutes: brain dump, tomorrow's One Thing, done for today.
settings.reminderReviewBody: About 20 minutes: facts, inbox, projects, next actions.
settings.dataBody: Everything stays on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere.
settings.importBody: This replaces everything on this device with the backup from {{date}}. Type {{word}} to confirm.
settings.importFailed: That file isn't a FOCUS backup.
settings.storageNotPersisted: Not protected yet. The browser may clear it when space runs low.
settings.deleteBody: This deletes all FOCUS data on this device. Type {{word}} to confirm.
settings.about: FOCUS {{version}}. Runs offline. Your data never leaves this device.
